    afterHdr, ROWS(labelCol) - hdrRow,

    nPairs, ROWS(pairIdx),
    nMonths, COLUMNS(monthCols),
    cellIdx, SEQUENCE(nPairs * nMonths),
    pairOf, MAP(cellIdx, LAMBDA(k, INDEX(pairIdx, INT((k - 1) / nMonths) + 1))),
    monOf, MAP(cellIdx, LAMBDA(k, MOD(k - 1, nMonths) + 1)),
    valAt, LAMBDA(i, m, IF(OR(m < 1, m > nMonths), 0, N(INDEX(wfRaw, hdrRow + i, INDEX(monthCols, 1, m))))),

    laterPos, MAP(pairOf, monOf, LAMBDA(i, m, SUMPRODUCT(--MAP(SEQUENCE(1, nMonths), LAMBDA(j, AND(j > m, valAt(i, j) > 0)))))),
    isStopped, MAP(booked, prior, laterPos, LAMBDA(b, p, lp, AND(b > 0, p > 0, b >= accelMult * p, b > p, lp = 0))),
    isReversal, MAP(booked, laterPos, LAMBDA(b, lp, AND(b < 0, lp > 0))),
    used, MAP(booked, prior, isStopped, isReversal, LAMBDA(b, p, st, rv, IF(st, p, IF(rv, MAX(p, 0), b)))),
    rawCust, MAP(pairOf, LAMBDA(i, IF(byCustomer, INDEX(parents, i), INDEX(names, i)))),
    plans, MAP(pairOf, LAMBDA(i, IF(byCustomer, INDEX(names, i), INDEX(parents, i)))),
    custs, MAP(rawCust, LAMBDA(c, IF(OR(c = "No counterparty", c = "No customer"), "", c))),
    oidx, MAP(custs, LAMBDA(c, IF(c = "", 0, IFERROR(MATCH(c, 'MRR settings'!$F$14:$F$63, 0), 0)))),

    descs, MAP(plans, booked, isStopped, isReversal, LAMBDA(p, b, st, rv, p & IF(st, " (adjusted: schedule stopped, booked " & TEXT(b, "$#,##0.00") & ")", IF(rv, " (adjusted: reversal, booked " & TEXT(b, "$#,##0.00") & ")", "")))),
    starts, MAP(monOf, LAMBDA(m, INDEX(monthStarts, 1, m))),
    keep, MAP(booked, used, LAMBDA(b, u, OR(b <> 0, u <> 0))),
    FILTER(HSTACK(starts, shown, descs, used, plans, MAP(cellIdx, LAMBDA(k, 1)), checks, starts,
      MAP(starts, LAMBDA(s, EDATE(s, 1))), used, rawCust, MAP(cellIdx, LAMBDA(k, "Waterfall")),
